newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady on T-bill buying, quarter-end demand.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady on T-bill buying, quarter-end demand.

text.p: The rouble was steady in calm trading on Friday as banks sought funds to invest in government securities and to close month- and quarter-end balance-sheets, dealers said.
"T-bill prices fell earlier (this week) and banks could prefer to invest in them as they are yielding more than dollar investments," one dealer said.
Avtobank dealer Sergei Gornev said: "The dollar is easing for no other reasons than T-bill buying and balance-squaring at the end of the month and quarter."

Roubles for today settlement were quoted at 5,397-5,400 per dollar compared with an early 5,399-5,402 and 5,393-96 late on Thursday. Tomorrow roubles were steady at 5,406-09 per dollar compared with yesterday's late 5,406-08.
The central bank said it had set 5,376/5,416 as its bid and offer rates against the dollar on Friday.
Overnight rouble credits yielded 20-40 percent compared with Thursday's late 5-10 percent.
